correctness.rationale: Direct algebra gives the required difference D=-pq+3p+3q+3. For p at least 11, setting E=-D excludes two non-q divisors by size and two q-multiples modulo q; the only remaining mixed case gives incompatible lower and upper bounds. Thus p is 3,5,7, where the divisor sets are finite and yield exactly the eight values. A fresh independent prime sweep below 150 reproduced exactly those eight values and explicit witness pairs; the proof supplies the unbounded exclusion.
